experiment.name: Swedish Lion comparison against reliability-2026-07-31
experiment.description: Runs SwedishLionAdapter (Riksarkivet/trocr-base-handwritten-hist-swe-2) over the exact same 600 InputCrop files (byte-identical, re-verified by hash before every call) that reliability-2026-07-31's sealed SATRN/Florence-2 run consumed. No new segmentation is performed. Same dataset sample, same preprocessing version, same reliability heuristics version and thresholds as that run -- only the recognition method and its model revision differ, so the two reports' per_method blocks are directly comparable. Reference-free technical reliability screening only -- no CER/WER, no ground truth.

software_environment.reused_crops_note: InputCrop bytes and content hashes are reused verbatim from reliability-2026-07-31's sealed segmentation output -- no new Florence-2 line detection was run. Verified by re-hashing each crop file from disk immediately before recognition.
